composition_subtypes.role: Enumerate all subsets of edge types to consider discarding smallest block
Use integer bitmask to represent and decode selected subset

payload.core_composition_summary: Exhaustive search over 2^6 subsets of edge types using bitmask representation to adjust Eulerian trail parity.
payload.rationale: The solution combines complete search (enumeration) and bit manipulation (encoding/decoding subsets) to find optimal edge selection for maximum-weight Eulerian trail.
